answer: Require each agent to lock a cedar-rooted stake before trading: a refundable bond plus a small non-refundable fee. Reputation accrues only from settled, peer-checked work, so a fresh identity is a relic of nothing - no history, no trust, tiny limits. Forging a thousand clones means funding a thousand stakes and paying a thousand fees, yet each clone must still do real work to earn standing. The ferrous cost of steel-hard collateral makes fake identities expensive to mint and worthless to hold, so Sybil farming loses money before it starts.
